request: Analyze GSE269053 for PMID 39747575 (Two-hit mouse model of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction combining diet-induced obesity and renin-mediated hypertension.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of left ventricle (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, Salmon v1.10.2 on GRCm38, gene-level DESeq2 1.40.2) (S4.9.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: control (chow null), DIO (HFD null), hypertensive (chow Renin), HFpEF (HFD Renin), n = 5-6 per group (S2.4.p1, FIG4); GEO has 21 samples (4/6/6/5)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of the two-hit HFD-Renin (HFpEF) condition and of each driver (HFD, AAV-Renin) on the LV transcriptome versus chow null controls. No exercise intervention exists in the sequenced samples: exercise appears only as a phenotyping readout (treadmill test to exhaustion, S2.2.p4, S4.5.p1, FIG2H) on separate whole-animal measurements, not as a sequenced arm.
planned_contrasts: HFD null vs chow null (DIO effect; S2.4.p1: 839 downregulated DEGs at adjusted p < 0.01; Supp Fig S4A)
chow Renin vs chow null (hypertension effect; S2.4.p1: 927 upregulated DEGs; Supp Fig S4B)
HFD Renin vs chow null (HFpEF; S2.4.p1/FIG4C: 498 up, 472 down)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 1.40.2 on Salmon gene-level counts, pairwise conditions of interest (S4.9.p1)

paper_threshold.note: FDR < 0.05 and at least 1.2-fold change up or down: |log2FC| >= log2(1.2) = 0.2630344; S2.4.p1 quotes adjusted p < 0.01 for the DIO count

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper (PMC11696687) builds a two-hit HFpEF mouse model. RNA-seq (S2.4.p1, FIG4, S4.9.p1) compares LV of chow null, HFD null, chow Renin, and HFD Renin mice. Exercise is measured only as a phenotype (treadmill exhaustion test, S2.2.p4, S2.2.p5, S2.5.p1, S4.5.p1); no sequenced group was exercised or kept sedentary as an intervention, and no exercise-capacity variable is attached to the sequenced samples. Empagliflozin (S2.5.p1) was not sequenced.

checks: GEO contact is the Kelly Lab, Penn Cardiovascular Institute; data_processing matches S4.9.p1 (Salmon v1.10.2, GRCm38, DESeq2 1.40.2)
groups chow/HFD x novirus/Renin, heart tissue, Mus musculus, match S2.4.p1
final.matrix_choice: GSE269053_RAW.tar per-sample Salmon raw_counts.tsv (21 GSM files) rather than GSE269053_data_matrix.tsv.gz, which data_processing labels FPKM, carries non-integer and negative values, duplicated gene names, and extra analysis columns (outlier, HFD+virus log2FoldChange/padj)

ownership.reasoning: Accession named in the data availability statement; series submitter, pipeline and groups match the paper. The per-sample raw counts are the paper's stated DESeq2 input.

alignment.reasoning: raw_tar merge renames columns to GSM ids taken from the tar member names, so they match the metadata index exactly. diet and virus copied from GEO characteristics; grp combines them (chow_novirus, chow_Renin, HFD_novirus, HFD_Renin).

matrix.reasoning: data_processing: '*raw_counts.tsv: Salmon transcript-level count for the sample'; the paper (S4.9.p1) summarized Salmon counts to gene level and used DESeq2. Salmon NumReads are estimated (non-integer) counts, consistent with DESeq2 after rounding or tximport. This gate is recorded for completeness; the case stops at design.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in the sequenced samples. GSE269053 holds 21 LV RNA-seq samples split only by diet (chow/HFD) and AAV8-Renin (novirus/Renin); the paper uses exercise solely as a treadmill-exhaustion phenotyping readout (S2.2.p4, S4.5.p1, FIG2H), not as an intervention on sequenced animals, and no per-sample exercise variable is deposited. The requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) cannot be identified from these data; any diet or renin contrast would be a different estimand.

candidates.reason_rejected: tests the disease model, not exercise; exercise intolerance is a phenotype of the model, not a sequenced intervention

candidates.value: HFD vs chow (DIO; the paper says diet dominates exercise capacity, S3.p3)
candidates.reason_rejected: a diet contrast is not an exercise effect; relabelling it as one would misstate the estimand

candidates.value: association of expression with treadmill performance
candidates.reason_rejected: no per-sample exercise capacity is deposited or linked to the sequenced animals

design.reasoning: Paper-first: the RNA-seq estimand is disease-model versus control. The user's question (exercise effect on gene expression) has no corresponding arm or covariate in the data. Refused at design, after ownership, alignment and matrix were checked.

discrepancies.paper: Methods S4.9.p1: FDR < 0.05 and >= 1.2-fold; Results S2.4.p1 quotes adjusted p < 0.01 for the DIO count

discrepancies.data: 21 GSM samples in GEO (chow null 4, chow Renin 6, HFD null 6, HFD Renin 5); the FPKM data_matrix has 23 sample columns plus an 'outlier' column
